source.title: Increased connectivity of hiPSC-derived neural networks in multiphase granular hydrogel scaffolds

material: Granular HA hydrogel, 2 w/v % granules + 20 v/v % secondary crosslinker (cell-laden)

formulation.component: secondary Extralink-1 (PEGDA) crosslinker, relative to primary
formulation.evidence: together with the secondary crosslinker at 20 v/v % of the primary crosslinker concentration
2 w/v % HyStem® hydrogel fragments were fabricated as shown in Section 2.3
resuspended in F20 Medium supplemented with 200 μg/ml laminin and 50 ng/ml BDNF

processing.evidence: the system was pre-gelled in a 1 ml syringe at 37 ◦C for 2.5 h
gel granules extruded through 40 μm pore diameters and having diameters of 69 ± 21 μm were chosen
incubated and gelled at 37 ◦C for 30 min after adding the secondary crosslinker

youngs_modulus.evidence: granular hydrogel mixed with solutions of secondary crosslinker at 10 v/v %, 20 v/v %, 30 v/v % and 50 v/v % (relative to the primary crosslinker concentration) acquired G′ values of 99 ± 43 Pa, 121 ± 25 Pa, 225 ± 60 Pa and 188 ± 28 Pa, respectively.

description.evidence: as they promoted low levels of cell clustering whilst also remaining intact throughout the 28-day culture period

duration_days.evidence: as they promoted low levels of cell clustering whilst also remaining intact throughout the 28-day culture period

biology.cell_type: hiPSC-derived neural progenitor cells/cortical neurons (line 010S-1 and AXOL13)

culture_days.evidence: Long-term culture (3 months) of AXOL13 NPCs in granular hydrogel composites.

viability_percent.evidence: after seven days in culture, cell viability in the granular hydrogel scaffolds remained significantly higher (Bulk: 36 ± 6%; Granular: 63 ± 7%)

neurite_length.evidence: (Bulk average neurite length: 16.69 ± 2.63 μm; Granular average neurite length: 53.38 ± 8.72 μm)

other_outcomes.evidence: After three days in culture, both hydrogel scaffolds were seen to support similar numbers of neurite bearing cells (Bulk: 8.89 ± 0.61; Granular: 10.0 ± 0.00; p = 0.088)
other_outcomes.name: number of neurite bearing cells (of up to 10) Day 3
number of neurite bearing cells (of up to 10) Day 7

survival.evidence: No significant difference in cell viability was observed on the first day of culture (bulk cell viability: 73 ± 6%; granular cell viability: 76 ± 3%)

After three days in culture, cell viability in granular hydrogels was found to be significantly higher than for cells encapsulated in bulk hydrogel (bulk cell viability: 40 ± 5%; granular cell viability: 60 ± 6%)
after seven days in culture, cell viability in the granular hydrogel scaffolds remained significantly higher (Bulk: 36 ± 6%; Granular: 63 ± 7%)

notes: Granules from 40 μm nylon mesh (69 ± 21 μm diameter, swollen); final ~1 w/v % granular hydrogel; ~10^7 cells/ml. SEM average pore size 1378 ± 157 μm2. G' measured cell-free by DWS microrheology at 37 °C. Long-term data partly with AXOL13 cells.
